title: Kissed American Yeast Biscuit
description: A classic American yeast biscuit recipe, featuring whole milk and score-fat, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together yeast and warm milk until dissolved.
Add sugar and let it sit for 5-7 minutes, or until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and cold butter until crumbly.
Add the egg and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the yeast mixture and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll it out to a thickness of 1 inch.
Cut out biscuits using a round cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 1 inch of space between each biscuit.
Brush the tops with a little bit of milk or egg wash for a golden finish.
